review_text: March 15 2026 This is night before Araw ng Davao. Got the hot ₱115 Oatmeal cookie and ₱115 Hot Espresso from Vietnam beans. I brought the espresso over to Kugi Slow Bar as I needed to finish it. The owner was cool and nice. Really does reflect the cafe. Glad they've finished the renovations.
Hopped off for coffees and a pastry. Affordable rates for the three items I got. Tasty coffee flavors. An open-air space with limited seating and curbside parking. Best to swing by in the mornings.

shop: the vibes is great and unique -- their branding and decors cater to the grunge and punk folks. the shop is street-facing and al fresco. gives neighborhood coffee shop feels (which it actually is) mocha: they used to have really dark tasting mocha around 2025 but now their mocha is a too sweet. i expected them to have that signature bitter (in a good way) taste but it's tasting more sugary. side note: i use mocha to compare different coffee shops & cafe

Found another gem in Davao. Great toasted coffee beans from Vietnam. A big plus for making the Cortana correctly! Aldrine the barista, was cool, chill and consistent. Thank you. A must come and I recommend for sure.

Stopped by Darkk Coffee and loved the vibe - super chill! The music being played on the speaker was totally nostalgic, and brought me back to high school. :) Coffee was just okay this time, though. Still, good spot to drop by!
Good brews. Clean vibe. Walang arte — just pure coffee and calm energy. 💀
Nice coffee and cookies one thing would improve the coffee is heating the milk a little more. Barista is friendly and good to chat with.

Darkk Coffee is a cozy, artisanal coffee shop that feels like a nostalgic step back to simpler times. The warm ambiance and friendly people evoke memories of teenage hangouts, while the expertly crafted offers a comforting taste of the past. It's a delightful spot for a peaceful, joyful coffee experience.
The one, the only 2nd best coffee shop in the city.
a little nook along the road...this place gives off great vibes for that quick coffee fix. tried the mocha and was very impressed with its taste and kick to it.
